skill.name: jma-weather
skill.description: Retrieve Japanese weather forecasts, precipitation probabilities, temperatures, and weekly outlooks from public Japan Meteorological Agency data without an API key.
skill.summary: Read regional JMA forecasts with matching time periods and publication timestamps.
skill.author: tahodev

content.user_title: Check Japanese Weather with Official JMA Forecasts
content.value_statement: Finding regional forecasts can require matching unfamiliar area codes and time periods. This skill guides your assistant through public JMA data without login credentials.
actual_capabilities: Find regional forecast office codes using JMA area definitions.
Retrieve short-term weather, precipitation probabilities, and temperature forecasts.
Read weekly precipitation probabilities and temperature ranges when available.
Retrieve the regional textual forecast overview.
Match forecast values to their time periods and include the JMA publication timestamp.
Handle invalid area codes, timeouts, server errors, and malformed responses using documented guidance.
limitations: Coverage is limited to Japanese forecast regions, not precise street-level conditions.
Warnings, advisories, earthquakes, and tsunami information are outside this skill.
Retrieval requires network access and curl; endpoint availability and response formats can change.
The referenced shared response checklist is not included in the supplied skill package.

use_cases.title: Review Weather Before Commuting
use_cases.description: Check your regional forecast and precipitation probabilities for the relevant travel periods.

use_cases.title: Compare Weekend Destination Forecasts
use_cases.description: Read available weekly forecasts for Japanese destinations, including temperature ranges and publication times.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Regional Weather Brief
use_cases.description: Retrieve the JMA textual overview and report source values with matching time periods.

prompt_templates.title: Check Tomorrow's Weather
prompt_templates.prompt: What is tomorrow's forecast for Tokyo? Include available precipitation probabilities, temperatures, and the JMA publication time.

prompt_templates.title: Review Travel Time Periods
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tomorrow's Osaka forecast for morning and evening travel. Match precipitation probabilities to available periods and include the JMA publication time.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Weekend Destinations
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare available weekend forecasts for Sapporo and Naha. Include precipitation probabilities, temperature ranges, publication times, and any missing values.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Regional Forecast Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve [region] using JMA office codes. Compare short-term and weekly periods, preserve source values, and report unavailable data without guessing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: verify regional mapping and response interpretation.

output_examples.input: Summarize this illustrative Tokyo forecast: cloudy, rain probability 40% from 12:00 to 18:00 JST, published at 11:00 JST.
The JMA forecast request timed out after 30 seconds and two retries. What should the weather response say?
output: The current JMA forecast could not be retrieved.
The JMA website may be unavailable.
Check the official JMA website directly.
No current forecast is reported because retrieval failed.

best_practices: Confirm the forecast office code before requesting data.
Match each value to its forecast period and include the JMA publication timestamp.
Use a request timeout, limit retries, and reuse cached responses only when their age is clearly stated.
anti_patterns: Use municipality codes directly where forecast office codes are required.
Invent missing forecast values or present stale cached data as current.
Use routine forecasts as substitutes for official severe weather warnings or emergency information.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The documented JMA endpoints provide public data without an API key or login.

faq.question: Which locations are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers Japanese regional forecast offices. It uses JMA area definitions to find the appropriate office code.

faq.question: Can it read a weekly forecast?
faq.answer: Yes. Weekly forecast data normally appears in the second forecast response element, with coverage up to seven days.

faq.question: Does it provide warnings or earthquake information?
faq.answer: No. Warnings, advisories, earthquakes, and tsunami information are explicitly outside its scope.

faq.question: What tools does retrieval require?
faq.answer: The examples use curl and internet access. Your assistant must also interpret the returned JSON data.

faq.question: What happens when JMA data cannot be retrieved?
faq.answer: The guidance limits retries and directs users to the official site. It prohibits invented forecasts and stale data presented as current.
